title: Planner: Capacity view shows who is working on what
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap, supplied Microsoft notice and Microsoft Learn support its rollout, default state, licensing and coarse Planner controls. It reports the Plan 5 entitlement and the notice's conflicting Plan 3 wording rather than silently choosing between them, and distinguishes the documented controls from the missing Capacity view switch.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Planner > Block turns off the Planner app at organisation level.
claims.quote:
In the left pane of the Teams admin center, go to Teams apps > Manage apps.
To turn off Planner for your organization, search for the Planner app, select it, and then select Block.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell provides Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app-id> -IsBlocked <Boolean> to change the app's tenant state.
claims.quote:
Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module
Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <String> [-IsBlocked <Boolean>]
-Id: Application ID of Microsoft Teams app.
-IsBlocked: The state of the app in the tenant.

claims.claim: The Teams organisation-level Block control blocks the whole Planner app for the organisation, not just Capacity view.
claims.quote:
You can turn off or turn on the app at the org level on the Manage apps page in the Teams admin center.
To turn off Planner for your organization, search for the Planner app, select it, and then select Block.

claims.claim: The cited Teams page does not say whether blocking Planner also affects Planner in Outlook.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner" "Outlook" "Block" Teams admin center. Opened manage-planner-app and get-planner-set-up-for-your-organization; the cited Teams page does not discuss Planner in Outlook or define blocking's effect there.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $false turns off Planner for the organisation within the disable-Planner page's scope.
claims.quote:
Turn off Planner for your organization using PowerShell
Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $false
To turn on Planner back:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $true

claims.claim: No admin centre UI equivalent for the organisation-wide IsPlannerAllowed control is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "turn off Planner" "admin center" IsPlannerAllowed; "Set-PlannerConfiguration" "IsPlannerAllowed" turn off Planner. Opened disable-planner and manage-planner-app; the latter blocks the Teams app, not the service-wide PowerShell configuration.

claims.claim: The disable-Planner page says a global admin runs the PowerShell configuration.
claims.quote: If you're a global admin and you want to turn off Microsoft Planner for your organization, you can use Windows PowerShell.
